notes: Six Purdue Krannert 'Distinguished PhD Alum' single-person profile pages, two Common Crawl captures each (CC-MAIN-2013-48 in December 2013 and CC-MAIN-2014-49 in November 2014); 12 texts read, 12 records written, none unreadable. sourceUrl is the index lookup address from each file footer and sourceDate is the capture timestamp date. Each snapshot directory also holds a May/June 2013 (CC-MAIN-2013-20) capture that is not listed in chunk-40.json; those captures belong to chunk-29 (Narayandas, Petruzzi, McAfee) and chunk-30 (Carraway, Jacob, Mookerjee) and are already recorded in proposal-29.json and proposal-30.json, so they were not re-recorded here. The December 2013 and November 2014 captures show the same name, title and institution as the 2013 captures for every person. All six pages state no year, program area, degree date or dissertation; destination and position are the current affiliation displayed on the profile (Harvard University; UIUC; Caltech; Darden; UTDallas x2), copied as written, which must not be read as the first job after the PhD. The person-page URLs differ in case (PhD vs phd) and host (www vs bare domain) between captures; the chunk key was kept for every row.
